## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands and outcomes. Distinguish fixture tests, live-device checks, CI
results, and skipped checks. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Compatibility and documentation

Note public API, platform, Rust toolchain, or export-format changes.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I reviewed CONTRIBUTING.md and followed the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I added appropriate coverage and documentation, or explained why none is needed.
- [ ] I reviewed logs and fixtures for private data and documented provenance and rights for new fixtures.
- [ ] My contribution preserves required third-party notices and can be contributed under the project's license.
